learning_objective: Child agrees to take turns and share.
scenario: You are playing with a new car. Your friend wants to play with it.

initial_prompt.tanglish: Indha car super ah irukku, naan konjam vilayadava?
initial_prompt.tamil: இந்த கார் சூப்பர் ஆ இருக்கு, நான் கொஞ்சம் விளையாடவா?
initial_prompt.english: This car is great, can I play for a while?
